authorized_extension: Separate improvement runs, combined run, development curve, then colleague comparison at the end
data: Only original train.csv (8335 rows); original Val and Test not opened or re-evaluated
evaluation: 3-fold StratifiedGroupKFold; group=source, stratum=language:label; every row out-of-fold once per candidate; same folds for all
initialization: Original frozen encoder only, never full-train classification heads; fit balanced C=1 logistic head separately inside each fold
training: Three fixed full-fold epochs, batch32, encoder_lr2e-5/head_lr2e-4, AdamW .01, warmup10%, bf16 training, final epoch only; same seed/order per paired fold

candidates.B0_frozen: Fold-fitted logistic head; frozen encoder; uniform chunks; fp32
candidates.R0_reference: Original three-epoch fine-tuning recipe refitted within each fold; inverse class-frequency CE; uniform chunks; fp32
candidates.R1_quality: R0 except per-example inverse frequency of language:label; equal weight per language/class cell
candidates.R2_article: R0 weights, token-count-weighted chunk probabilities plus title/hidden-content/duplicate-aware HTML extraction
candidates.R3_deploy: R0 weights stored and inferred in bf16 on CUDA; bounded API inference queue and finite-score validation
candidates.R4_combined: R1 training + R2 article handling + R3 deployment

selection: Highest mean source-group CV macro-F1; candidates within 0.005 absolute prefer lower median per-text CUDA latency, then artifact bytes; no deployment change based on final branch benchmark
article_checks: Fixed synthetic DE/EN financial texts and HTML extraction fixtures; measured separately; not independent human-labelled real-article accuracy; no tuning after results
release: Fit selected training recipe once on all original training rows; independent artifact, preserve v1; do not use old Val or Test
comparison_at_end: Freeze our selection first. Then run colleague original default method unmodified in isolated checkout and ours on a new shared external benchmark. Prefer SEntFiN unanimous-entity headlines, 200/class by seed, native English and separately identified machine-translated German. Remove normalized overlap with both training corpora. Never compare the old 0.720 and 0.719 as paired scores.
external_limit: No trusted real-article labels supplied; machine-translated German is a transfer check, not native German gold; no real-world article accuracy claim
latency: Warm CUDA, batch1, tokenizer/transfers included; 20 independent warmups, paired same-order fold sample up to180 rows; report p50/p95 and median across folds
evidence: MLflow experiment article-sentiment-second-path, stage/fold tags, parameters, accuracy, macro_f1, per-class F1, language scores, negative recall/precision, confusion matrices, latency, bytes; immutable original reports
